brief: Payout workers lose money and sometimes hang; INCIDENT.md has the logs. The workers are separate processes that share nothing but the store in ledger/store.py. Find the cause and fix ledger/wallet.py so that credits and transfers running at the same time never lose or create money and never hang, a transfer never takes a wallet below zero, a transfer to the same wallet changes nothing, and work on different wallets never waits for other wallets. Keep the functions' signatures and the store's interface.
